criteria.description: Proposes an NSM that measures delivered customer value / engagement quality (e.g. a value-moment rate), not a cumulative vanity metric.
Explicitly explains why raw MAU (vanity) and ad revenue (lagging result the team can't directly move) are NOT the right North Star, rather than adopting them.
Decomposes the NSM into 3-5 input metrics the team can directly influence, showing how they relate.
Includes guardrail metric(s) that must not regress (e.g. trust, content quality, churn).
Considers whether the NSM is leading vs lagging and whether it can be gamed without helping users (e.g. clickbait inflating sessions), and addresses it.
